messages:
samuel: Heads up — npm publish for @redwood/node-sdk 0.3.2 is failing CI. regen check is showing diffs after the recent typegen bump. stack is openapi -> typegen -> codegen. Anyone seen this before?

devex-bot: regen-check workflow failed on release/0.3.x (job: regen-compare). Summary: 12 files changed. See logs: https://ci.internal/1790123456/regen

maria: saw the same when trying to publish python SDK earlier. Looks like generated examples have reordered properties — tests expecting stable order are failing.

aj: CI snippet: ```
FAIL test_samples.py::test_roundtrip
- expected: {"items": ["a", "b"]}
+ got:      {"items": ["b", "a"]}
```

samuel: that ordering change smells like the typegen dict->map iteration change. Was told 2.1.0 removed the stable-key sort to speed up generation. Is that a semver-major?

maria: It's a breaking change for consumers who snapshot generated output. For SDKs we treat codegen output as an implementation detail, but our regen-check requires exact matches. We need either to normalize output in codegen or revert typegen bump in release branch.

aj: Proposal: revert the typegen bump on release/0.3.x (patch path), cut a patch that keeps prior behavior, and land a proper breaking change with a major semver and a changelog explaining the regen diff.

samuel: agree. For the immediate unblock I can run `make regen` across node/python/go locally and push the normalized files if tests pass. If those diffs are intentional we still need a changelog entry.

ci-bot: retriggered pipeline for branch release/0.3.x (build #1790123468)

maria: I opened a tiny PR that canonicalizes object key order in the codegen step instead of relying on typegen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2384 — this should make generated outputs deterministic again.

aj: nice. That avoids a revert. Two follow-ups: 1) update typegen to 2.1.1 with stable-sort restored or document breaking change, 2) add a note to the release checklist to run regen locally before cut.

samuel: running local regen now: `docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/src redwood/codegen:latest make regen` — will push if green.

devex-bot: FYI — release-bot marked the 0.3.2 publish as blocked until regen diffs are resolved.

maria: pushed fix for canonicalization + regen run for node and python. CI is green on my fork. I also added a small changelog line under Unreleased: "fix: deterministic codegen output (regen diffs)".

aj: once CI completes on the branch, we should `npm publish --tag next` for a quick smoke and then `npm publish` when all greens. Also confirm no user-facing API changes (we didn't change surface).

samuel: CI on release branch passed. I'll merge the canonicalize PR and then cut the patch. Planning to `npm publish --tag next` in ~15m.

ci-bot: build #1790123521 succeeded. publish job queued.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks all. Created follow-up issue to add regen-check to the release checklist and capture typegen semver guidance.

samuel: publishing done — `npm publish` succeeded and docs site build passed. Closing thread. :party_parrot:

devex-bot: thread closed by samuel (action: release-unblocked)
